item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00317","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C04","C13","C20"],"selected_candidate_label":"C04","confidence":0.96,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C04 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. It addresses the identical area-redevelopment problem and contains a distinctive cluster reused in the child: communities suffering substantial, persistent, or chronic unemployment; federal assistance combined with local governmental and private participation; loans and public-works assistance; and assignment of the program to the Department of Commerce because of its business-development and technical-aid experience. The child converts C04's veto explanation and promised replacement legislation into an affirmative request for enactment while retaining much of its policy architecture. C13 and C20 also share unusually close program-specific material, but C04 offers the strongest combination of language and administrative machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"areas of substantial and persistent unemployment","parent_excerpt":"communities of substantial and persistent unemployment","explanation":"Near-verbatim identification of the program's intended beneficiaries."},{"child_excerpt":"a cooperative effort in which the Federal Government joins with private industry and local and state governments","parent_excerpt":"local judgments backed by significant local contributions","explanation":"Both make federal redevelopment assistance depend upon participation by local government and private interests."},{"child_excerpt":"technical assistance, loans for private projects, loans and grants for public facilities","parent_excerpt":"loans...of redevelopment projects...a program of Federal grants for public works in redevelopment areas","explanation":"The child carries forward substantially the same assistance machinery."},{"child_excerpt":"the department best equipped to supervise and coordinate the program is the Department of Commerce","parent_excerpt":"Such a program should be lodged...with the Department of Commerce which has primary responsibility for business and industrial development and a long experience in extending to local areas technical aid for economic development.","explanation":"This is a particularly distinctive shared administrative choice supported by nearly the same rationale."},{"child_excerpt":"I urge prompt consideration and enactment of an area redevelopment bill.","parent_excerpt":"request the Congress to enact area assistance legislation more soundly conceived...move with all possible speed to enact such an area assistance program","explanation":"The child's operative request fulfills and closely tracks C04's promised request for replacement legislation."}]}
